meta.name: muapi-music-video
meta.description: Build a short music video from a song theme — N keyframes, animate each, generate matching music.

copy.tagline: 根据歌曲主题自动生成音乐短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速把歌曲主题变成带动画和配乐的短视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate a short music video from a song theme automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a song theme into a short video with animation and music

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 根据你提供的歌曲主题，自动生成一段短音乐视频：先创建N个关键帧画面和一段配乐，再把每个画面变成5秒动画，最后输出所有素材和剪辑顺序说明。
howto.when: 当你提到“音乐视频”、“MV”、“视频故事”或“歌曲可视化”等关键词，并给出歌曲主题时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于孤独机器人找朋友的MV，3个场景。
say.note: 会生成3个5秒片段和配乐。

say.text: 用赛博朋克风格做一首歌的可视化视频，5个场景。
say.note: 会按你指定的视觉风格生成。

howto.what_en: Given a song theme, it generates a short music video: creates N keyframes and a music track, then animates each keyframe into a 5-second clip, returning all assets and a cut order summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "music video", "MV", "video story", or "song visualization" and provide a song theme.

say_en.text: Make an MV about a lonely robot finding a friend, 3 scenes.
Create a song visualization in cyberpunk style, 5 scenes.
